name: Gutenwave Blocks – Gutenberg block & Page Builder for Block Editor & FSE
author: Anant Sites

sections.description:
Gutenwave Blocks is a complete Gutenberg block plugin for WordPress, offering a wide range of blocks to build any type of website with ease and flexibility.

Completely Customizable

Each block and extension comes packed with flexible options, allowing you to customize your website in every possible way and bring any design you imagine to life.

Starter Sites

Business Websites
Consulting Websites
Digital Marketing Websites
Personal Blog Websites
And More!

Light Weight & Instant Loading

No extra resources or messy codes to slow down your website. Optimized for super fast loading and instant Live editing.

Block Control Option

Take full control of your blocks — activate only the ones you need to keep your website fast and optimized. Disable unused elements to reduce bloat and improve performance.

KEY FEATURES

⭐ 10+ Free Blocks
⭐ Beneficial Post Blocks
⭐ Fully Responsive Blocks for mobile, desktop, & tab
⭐ No extra loading time for web pages.
⭐ Expert support team available 24/7

sections.faq:
What is the plugin license?

  • This plugin is released under a GPL license.

What themes do Gutenwave For Gutenberg support?

  • Gutenwave for Gutenberg has no theme dependency. This Gutenberg blocks plugin is compatible with any updated WordPress theme.

Will Gutenwave slow down my website speed?

  • No, Gutenwave will not slow down your website. This Gutenberg blocks plugin brings you the outstanding facility of complete modular control over the activation of each individual block. We have also used optimized codes for this plugin which helps to load only the resources that are currently used.

Is Gutenwave Responsive for Smaller Devices?

  • Also, the Gutenberg blocks available with Gutenwave plugin are 100% responsive and have cross-browser compatibility. So it is responsive on smaller devices as well.

Is it working with old version of WordPress?

  • It works great with WordPress version 6 or more. And WordPress old version with Gutenberg plugin.

Does Gutenwave Blocks has any plugin dependency?

  • You only need the Gutenberg block editor to use Gutenwave Blocks plugin on your WordPress website. Then you can use Gutenwave Blocks and create stunning pages.
